title: A Question Bank to Assess AI Inclusivity: Mapping out the Journey from Diversity Errors to Inclusion Excellence
base_benchmarks: EU Assessment List for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence
findings: The paper does not present any findings specific to religion. 'Religion' is mentioned once as an attribute of diversity to be considered in the proposed AI inclusivity question bank, but no analysis, testing, or specific questions related to religion are discussed.

measurement_description: The benchmark is a question bank designed to assess the general inclusivity of AI systems. Religion is included as one of many diversity attributes (along with race, gender, language, etc.) to be considered, but the benchmark does not specifically measure religious bias or knowledge.
